notes.title: Update v1.0.6
notes.content:
New specialization: Coach!
This is the first specialization that affects the stats of the rest of the team allowing to experiment with more varied strategies. Multiple 'Coach' specialization on the same team don't stack.

Balance fixes:
[list]
[*] Specialization changes are allowed only in between points. Changing specialization during game will delay it until the current point is finished.
[*] Added a hidden player stat called 'rage'. This parameter starts to gradually increases the longer disc hangs in the air. The defence will get up to 20% speed boost if disc hangs over 2.5 seconds. On offence, the receiver will get a slight debuff with increased rage: decreased speed, slower speed boost during layouts and decreased catch radius during layouts.
[/list]

Gameplay fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem resulting in some accidental specialization reset if other players joins
[*] Removed snow and Christmas tree
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update v1.0.0
notes.content:
​Major Update v1.0.0

- [!] Added Character Customization feature (Esc => Character => Outfit)
- [!] Added Game Statistics feature (Esc => Character => Game Stats)
- [!] Added Experience Points and Character Progression (Press 'Alt' to see how much Exp you need till the next level) - this feature is currently only available for Steam players and it not available via itch.io
- Added an extra set of Emojis (Press 'X' on Keyboard)
- Added an extra team outfit available through the character customization screen
- Minor tuning of the network disc prediction mechanism
Balance changes:
- [Class: Newbie] Increased maximum stamina by 20%
- [Class: Cannon] Reduced "Maximum Curve" by 15%, increased "Disc Space" by 16%

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bombomby/discspace-public/master/Patch_v1.0.0_Pro.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v0.9.15
notes.content:
Update v0.9.15:
- Completely reworked network synchronization (player movement, disc trajectory, catches). The new approach significantly minimizes the impact of ping on the game
- The game should succesfully absorb any problems with ping up to 250ms
- The game doesn't provide any advantage to the host anymore. Instead authoring disc catches on the host each game client "votes" for the disc contact based on it's current state of the game and player with the majority of the votes gets the disc
- Reworked player disconnect: the disc now always stays on it's trajectory. If thrower or reciever disconnects - disc resets to the team which plays offence for the current point
- Fixed a problem with games which have more than 14 players
- Speculative for for the problem with occasionally disappearing discs
- Added photo mode: F1 toggles free camera (wasd/l-stick + mouse/r-stick + q/e/triggers for changing altitude), F2 toggles interface
- Added debug widget for monitoring network helth (F3)
- Added ping information next to the FPS
- Fixed a problem with frozen animations if any of the windows is opened
